items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: he was a nice trumpet player too, but I had to talk to Deek

ctx.x: how some of the guys got into a fight over her This Deek Wilson--it wasn't really a fighting over some other member of the group, but this Deek was going with Clarice and if some outsider--you know you've got to be good and courteous and everything and especially when she made up and everything, she was in this dance act with a one legged dancer, you know, and if some young man or something smiled at Clarice too much, Deek would go and knock him in the head, and it just got to be ridiculous.
It was so much trouble--he was a nice trumpet player too, but I had to talk to Deek, but the young man, if the moon changed he would change.
